w = 0.1:1:100;

G = tf([20],[conv([1,0],[1,1])]);

Gc = tf([0.4,1],[0.039,1]);

G1 = series(G,Gc);

% 绘制待校正系统、超前校正网络和已校正系统的对数幅频渐近线

figure(1);

[x,y] = bd_asymp(G,w);

[xc,yc] = bd_asymp(Gc,w);

[x1,y1] = bd_asymp(G1,w);

semilogx(x,y,'r');hold on

semilogx(xc,yc,'b');semilogx(x1,y1,'k');grid;hold off
